test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per the Forest Survey Report 2021, the state of _______ has the highest forest cover as a percentage of total geographical area.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Forest cover of Mizoram**

__
 
• Minister for Environment, Forest and Climate Change, Bhupender Yadav, **released the 'Indian State of Forest Report 2021' on 13 January 2022.**
 
• According to the report, **Mizoram has ****the highest forest cover** as a percentage of the total geographical area.
 
• The forest cover **percentage of Mizoram is **84.53%**.**
 
• Followed by Mizoram **the second highest cover has Arunachal Pradesh, then Manipur and Nagaland respectively.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Forest cover of Arunachal Manipur and Nagaland**

 
• **Arunachal Pradesh has a forest cover of 79.33%** as a percentage of the total geographical area.
 
• **Manipur has a forest cover of **74.34**%** as a percentage of the total geographical area..
 
• **Nagaland has a forest cover of **73.90% as a percentage of the total geographical area..
